facts.fact: The BCEAO states that payment institutions in the UMOA, Guinea-Bissau among the eight states, are licensed under its Instruction n°001-01-2024 on payment services, and 34 were approved at 31 August 2026.
facts.system: BCEAO Instruction n°001-01-2024 relative aux services de paiement dans l'UMOA

facts.fact: The BCEAO list at 31 August 2026 shows one payment institution licensed in Guinea-Bissau, INTOUCH Guinée-Bissau (EP.GB.001/2025), approved on 25 June 2025.
